operations.meaning: Validate two equal finite sides, strict complete preference permutations and synthetic evidence fields.
Return exact zero-based receiver ranks for every proposer preference order.
Return exact zero-based proposer ranks for every receiver preference order.
Run proposer-initiated deferred acceptance and retain every proposal, hold and rejection event.
Return the proposer-initiated deferred-acceptance matching in canonical pair order.
Run the symmetric receiver-initiated procedure and translate the result to proposer-receiver pairs.
Enumerate every pair whose members both strictly prefer one another to their assigned partners.
Bind a complete matching to an empty blocking-pair set without treating stability as social optimality.
Report both sides' exact partner ranks for a matching; ranks are descriptive, not welfare authority.
Exhaust every bijection for n at most five and retain all and only stable matchings.
Count the exact finite stable set obtained by exhaustive enumeration.
Compare both deferred-acceptance extremes through exact partner ranks without inventing aggregate welfare.
Return each participant's best and worst attainable partner ranks across the finite stable set.
State whether the finite profile has exactly one stable matching and bind the supporting set size.
Swap the two sides and verify that translated stable matchings preserve the exact stable set.
Apply one frozen adjacent preference swap and compare stable-set additions, removals and retained matchings.
Compute exact pairwise Hamming distances among stable matchings and preserve the full finite spectrum.
Represent a synthetic allocation-record analogy while withholding decisions about real people or institutions.
Record that no real preferences, participants, outcomes, satisfaction measures or affected-user evidence were observed.
Hold real allocation, eligibility, fairness, legal and affected-party decisions behind competent authority and evidence.

boundary: Finite synthetic same-owner software and documentation evidence only; no independent reproduction, empirical GMUT confirmation, production THOS or Freed ID, professional, legal, cultural, affected-party or Maori authority, consciousness, personhood, Theory-of-Everything proof or Stage 20 readiness.
